quizzes.title: Cosmic Wonders
quizzes.description: Test your knowledge of the universe, stars, planets, and space exploration!

questions.question: What is the approximate age of the Universe?
questions.explanation: Scientific measurements, such as those from the Planck satellite, estimate the age of the universe to be approximately 13.8 billion years.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the most moons?
questions.explanation: Saturn has the most confirmed moons in our solar system, with over 140 confirmed moons, overtaking Jupiter.

questions.question: What is the name of the first human-made satellite launched into space?
questions.explanation: Sputnik 1 was launched by the Soviet Union on October 4, 1957, marks the beginning of the Space Age.

questions.question: What is the closest star system to Earth?
questions.explanation: Alpha Centauri is the closest star system to Earth, located about 4.37 light-years away. Proxima Centauri is the individual closest star within this system.

questions.question: What happens at the event horizon of a black hole?
options: The escape velocity exceeds the speed of light
Matter is converted directly into energy
questions.correctAnswer: The escape velocity exceeds the speed of light
questions.explanation: The event horizon is the boundary around a black hole where the escape velocity is greater than the speed of light. Nothing, not even light, can escape once inside it.

quizzes.title: Ancient Civilizations
quizzes.description: Journey back in time to test your knowledge of Egypt, Rome, Greece, and Mesoamerica.

questions.question: Which Pharaoh's tomb was discovered almost completely intact by Howard Carter in 1922?
questions.explanation: King Tutankhamun's tomb (KV62) in the Valley of the Kings was discovered nearly intact in 1922, offering unprecedented insights into ancient Egyptian royal life.

questions.question: What was the primary language spoken in the Roman Empire?
questions.explanation: Latin was the official language of the Roman Empire, though Greek was widely spoken as a lingua franca in the Eastern Mediterranean.

questions.question: The Code of Hammurabi, one of the earliest written legal codes, originated in which ancient empire?
questions.explanation: The Code of Hammurabi was enacted by the Babylonian king Hammurabi around 1754 BCE in ancient Mesopotamia (modern-day Iraq).

questions.question: Which ancient civilization constructed the city of Machu Picchu?
questions.explanation: Machu Picchu is a 15th-century Inca citadel located in the Eastern Cordillera of southern Peru, built for the Inca emperor Pachacuti.

quizzes.title: General Trivia Blitz
quizzes.description: A quick run through random facts, pop culture, geography, and fun trivia.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions, covering about 30% of the Earth's surface.

questions.question: How many bones are there in an adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones, whereas a newborn baby actually has around 270 bones (many of which fuse together over time).

questions.question: Which country is the home of the kangaroo?
questions.explanation: Kangaroos are marsupials that are indigenous to the continent of Australia.

quizzes.title: JavaScript Basics
quizzes.description: A quiz testing core JS fundamentals.

questions.question: Which keyword is used to declare a block-scoped local variable?
questions.explanation: 'let' allows you to declare variables that are limited in scope to the block, statement, or expression on which it is used.
